alignment_correction: Phase 1 treated any nonzero center delta as a directional winner. Phase 1B aligns the robustness question to the already-deployed 7% Fair Trade threshold and 20% Slight/Strong threshold. These thresholds are not estimated from Phase 1 results.

recommended_ui_semantics.center_fair: Do not show a directional robustness label; the live verdict is already Fair Trade.
recommended_ui_semantics.direction_robust: Sensitivity Robust — the same side remains favored by at least the live 7% threshold in the deterministic adverse corner.
recommended_ui_semantics.flipped_direction: Sensitivity Fragile — the adverse corner changes which side is favored by at least 7%.
recommended_ui_semantics.not_probability: Never display a probability or confidence percentage from this sensitivity envelope.
recommended_ui_semantics.softened_to_fair: Sensitivity Fragile — the current favored side falls back into the live Fair Trade band.
